evals.prompt: Use /sealos-deploy for a local project. Stop after you prepare the Sealos YAML.
evals.expected_output: Phase 0 writes the four-field analysis artifact. The workflow does not inspect an existing deployment or create a cloud application.

assertions.name: writes-phase-zero-analysis
assertions.description: Writes runtime_profile, work_dir, repo_name, and github_url.

assertions.name: materializes-source
assertions.description: Uses a complete source workspace and preserves local changes.

assertions.name: does-not-run-mode-detection
assertions.description: Does not enter UPDATE or inspect live workloads.

assertions.name: creates-phase-log
assertions.description: Writes one phase log without secrets.

evals.prompt: Use /sealos-deploy for an unchanged sandbox GitHub clone. The kb-0.9 catalog has one exact spec.gitRepo match.
evals.expected_output: Phase 1 reads the current kb-0.9 catalog directory and saves the exact matched YAML. Phase 4 materializes that YAML, runs the deployment gate, and stops.

assertions.name: uses-exact-repository-match
assertions.description: Matches only one exact spec.gitRepo value.

assertions.name: saves-live-official-yaml
assertions.description: Copies the current matched catalog YAML to .sealos/phase-1/official-template.yaml and records its pointer.

assertions.name: materializes-in-phase-four
assertions.description: Writes .sealos/template/index.yaml during Phase 4.

assertions.name: stops-after-yaml
assertions.description: Does not collect inputs, dry-run a cluster, or deploy resources.

evals.prompt: Use /sealos-deploy for a local repository with a Compose application, PostgreSQL, Redis, and a worker that needs a Dockerfile.
evals.expected_output: Phase 2 writes one canonical Compose source and a deployment plan. It retains every related component and prepares the worker Dockerfile without building it.

assertions.name: uses-gitingest-for-deployment-evidence
assertions.description: Writes the bounded gitingest digest.

assertions.name: keeps-full-topology
assertions.description: Keeps the application, database, cache, and worker.

assertions.name: writes-single-source-pointer
assertions.description: Writes deployment_source only in deployment-plan.json.

assertions.name: does-not-build-in-phase-two
assertions.description: Prepares Dockerfiles but does not build or push an image.

evals.prompt: Generate the Phase 4 YAML for a standard source with one repository-built API and one upstream PostgreSQL image.
evals.expected_output: Phase 4 requests Phase 3 only for the API, returns to Phase 4 with a GHCR digest, pins every emitted image, and writes one YAML file.

assertions.name: builds-only-required-service
assertions.description: Does not build the upstream PostgreSQL image.

assertions.name: uses-sequential-builds
assertions.description: Runs no more than one build Subagent at a time.

assertions.name: writes-aggregate-build-result
assertions.description: Writes one Phase 3 digest and pull-access result.

assertions.name: pins-images
assertions.description: Uses repository@sha256 image references in the final YAML.

evals.prompt: Prepare a Sealos YAML from a Helm chart that has an application, a database, a worker, and an Ingress.
evals.expected_output: Phase 4 copies and renders the selected chart, converts the rendered resources, writes a resource map, runs only the deployment-gate subset, and stops.

assertions.name: uses-selected-helm-source
assertions.description: Does not replace the selected chart with Compose.

assertions.name: writes-rendered-source
assertions.description: Writes .sealos/phase-4/rendered.yaml.

assertions.name: writes-resource-map
assertions.description: Writes .sealos/phase-4/resource-map.json.

assertions.name: does-not-run-quality-gate
assertions.description: Runs the deployment-gate rule subset only.

evals.prompt: The final template gate passes. Continue the sealos-deploy lifecycle.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports the YAML and log paths. It states that it stopped after Phase 4 without deployment.

assertions.name: reports-final-yaml
assertions.description: Reports .sealos/template/index.yaml.

assertions.name: reports-log
assertions.description: Reports the single phase log path.

assertions.name: prohibits-later-phases
assertions.description: Does not run Phase 4.5, Phase 4.9, Phase 5, Phase 5.5, or UPDATE.

assertions.name: does-not-mutate-application-resources
assertions.description: Does not call the Template API or apply YAML with kubectl.
